description: ADCOS stable protocol envelope (spec/architecture.md section 7). Unknown top-level fields and unknown extension entries are forward-compatibility surface: conformant parsers preserve them when proxying, never coerce or rewrite known fields, and never let an extension shadow a standard envelope field. An extension entry whose value is an object carrying "required": true is a required-to-understand extension; processors that do not understand it must fail safely. Canonical serialization rules and the provisional status of the compact codec are declared in spec/schemas/protocol.json.

correlation_id.description: Optional correlation identifier associating messages of a larger interaction; absent where not applicable.

evidence.description: Evidence references carried by the message; opaque/reference-bearing at the envelope level (provenance semantics are grounded in the WORK-002 evidence model and later trust work).

expires_at.description: Expiration instant, RFC 3339 UTC with Z suffix. Must satisfy expires_at >= issued_at; temporal metadata is validated before an envelope is accepted for processing.

extensions.description: Forward-compatibility surface. Entries are preserved verbatim by parsers that do not own them; an object-valued entry carrying "required": true must be understood or the envelope fails safely.

issued_at.description: Issuance instant, RFC 3339 UTC with Z suffix.

message_id.description: Message-instance identifier. Not coupled to NodeID, access technology, radio bearer, transport connection, or implementation process identity.

message_type.description: Dotted message-type identifier. Well-formed unregistered types are handled per explicit policy (reject safely or transport opaquely); malformed types are rejected. The grammar is declared in spec/schemas/protocol.json and must match this pattern mechanically.

payload.description: Typed application/protocol content; message payload schemas expand in later Work Items. Unconstrained at the envelope level.

protocol.description: Protocol identifier of the ADCOS envelope.

sender.description: Sender identity reference, opaque at the envelope level; cryptographic identity semantics are owned by WORK-004.

algorithm.description: Opaque or registry-backed algorithm/profile identifier (LOCK-015 cryptographic agility; no algorithm is hard-coded).

signature.description: Signature metadata, opaque at this layer. WORK-003 provides deterministic canonical signature-input material only; signing, verification, keys, and trust policy are owned by later security Work Items.

version.description: Protocol major version of this envelope (the frozen conceptual baseline is 1). Incompatible majors are rejected safely.

title: ADCOS Protocol Envelope
